falseSynonyms.zh: communicate 重點是交換資訊；interact 更廣，可包含行為、反應和彼此影響。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The teams communicate by email. Visitors interact with the exhibit by touching the screen.

falseSynonyms.zh: engage 常帶積極投入意味；interaction 可以很短暫或中性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Students interact in pairs. Students engage deeply with the reading.

falseSynonyms.zh: exchange 強調來回交換某物／資訊；interaction 不一定有可明確「交換」的內容。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON They exchanged ideas after the meeting. The two groups interacted throughout the event.

falseSynonyms.zh: collaborate 必須有共同任務或產出；interaction 本身不要求合作。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The departments collaborated on a joint report. The departments interacted during the conference.

falseSynonyms.zh: participate 只表示加入活動，不保證與他人有雙向互動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She participated in the workshop. She interacted with other participants.

falseSynonyms.zh: respond 只描述對刺激作反應；interaction 通常至少涉及雙向或持續作用。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The device responded to the command. The user interacted with the device.

falseSynonyms.zh: socialise 限於人際社交；interaction 也可發生在人與系統、化學物質或其他事物之間。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Guests socialised after dinner. Users interact with the software.

falseSynonyms.zh: interact 是動詞；interaction 是名詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Children interact during play. The study examines social interaction.
